description: New Ulm, MN – U.S. Representative Brad Finstad issued the following statement after winning re-election to represent Minnesota’s First Congressional District. “I spoke with Jeff Ettinger this evening and thanked him for a hard-fought race,” said Finstad. “Although we have differing opinions, Jeff ran a strong campaign and I thanked him for his candidacy.” “Family pocketbooks […]
